rule: Baselines are measured at GATE-P3, never invented earlier. baseline==null requires baseline_set_at=='P3'; a non-null baseline requires baseline_set_at of P3 or later.

ratchet_policy.statement: A change may not make any measured critical path materially worse without an explicit, registered performance exception.
ratchet_policy.exception_process: Exception record with owner, reason, threshold definition, and review/expiry date; tracked like feature-flag metadata.
